alert.base_cold: The base is cold: no power for heating!
alert.shutdown.excavator: The excavator shut off: not enough power!
alert.shutdown.greenhouse: The greenhouse shut off: not enough power!
alert.shutdown.o2gen: The oxygen generator shut off: not enough power or water!
alert.shutdown.recycler: The water recycler shut off: not enough power!
app.tagline: Pack the lander. Run the Moon base. Bring everyone home.
app.title: Pack & Survive
briefing.intro: Commander, you lead a crew of 4 to a base at the Moon's south pole. Survive 30 days! Earth sends one lander. It can carry only {mass} mass units.
briefing.kenji: Kenji talks to you from Mission Control on Earth.
briefing.l1.d: The lander is small. Choose wisely.
briefing.l2.d: Air, water, food and heat all need power.
briefing.l3.d: One spare part can change the ending.
briefing.l4.d: You cannot see it, but it builds up every day.
briefing.title: Mission briefing
common.scientistHint: Shows exact numbers and source links.
ending.evacBody: The lander takes off and the whole crew gets home safe on Earth. Nobody is hurt. Let's see what happened.
ending.successBody: All 30 days done and everyone is safe. Great commanding!
events.darkness.body: The long dark is here. Solar panels give no power until the sun returns. Save energy, or keep everything running?
events.darkness.cost.keep: Uses the battery fast. If it runs out, systems shut off.
events.darkness.cost.save: Greenhouse and excavator pause for 3 days. Dim lights save 1 power, but morale dips.
events.darkness.result.keep: Everything keeps humming. Watch the battery!
events.darkness.result.save: Lights are dim and it is chilly, but the battery will last longer.
events.darkness.title: The sun sets for 3 days!
events.dust.body: Dust is clinging to the solar panels and blocking sunlight (20% less power).
events.dust.cost.clean: Walk to the panels and hold the button for 3 seconds. A tiring chore.
events.dust.cost.ignore: 20% less solar power until someone cleans them.
events.dust.result.ignore: The dust stays. You can clean it later from the panel.
events.dust.title: Sticky Moon dust on the panels
events.home.body: Kenji at Mission Control has a call for you and the crew.
events.home.cost.call: Morale goes up a lot, but it uses 1 extra power today.
events.home.cost.data: Earn a science star, but no morale boost.
events.home.result.data: Data sent! Mission Control is thrilled. Science star earned!
events.home.title: A message from home!
events.leak.body: Hiss... air is escaping from the habitat. Can you find the leak by following the hot/cold hint?
events.leak.cost.ignore: You lose 4 oxygen a day for 4 days.
events.leak.cost.patch: Walk around the habitat, follow hot/cold, then hold the button on the leak.
events.leak.result.ignore: The leak hisses on for a few days. That is a lot of air lost.
events.leak.title: A small air leak!
events.meteoroid.body: A tiny space rock cracked the panels. Output is cut in half until they are repaired.
events.meteoroid.cost.ignore: Only half the solar power from now on.
events.meteoroid.cost.spare: Uses 1 spare part. Walk to the panels and hold the button.
events.meteoroid.result.ignore: The panels keep working at half power.
events.meteoroid.title: A micrometeoroid hit the solar panels!
events.mold.body: Fuzzy mold is growing on the leaves. What should we do?
events.mold.cost.airflow: Uses 1 extra power a day for 3 days.
events.mold.cost.cut: Half the greenhouse food for 3 days.
events.mold.result.airflow: The fans dry the leaves. The plants are safe!
events.mold.result.cut: Moldy leaves removed. Fewer veggies for a few days.
events.mold.title: Mold on the greenhouse plants!
events.recycler_break.body: The module is blinking red. Without it the crew drinks much more of the stored water.
events.recycler_break.choice.spare: Fix it with a spare part
events.recycler_break.cost.ration: 3 days of half water and a grumpy crew, then a patch job fixes it.
events.recycler_break.cost.spare: Uses 1 spare part. Walk to the recycler and hold the button.
events.recycler_break.result.ration: Rationing it is. In 3 days the crew finishes a patch job.
events.recycler_break.title: The water recycler broke!
events.rock.body: A glowing rock sits out on the plains. Scientists on Earth would love a scan of it.
events.rock.cost.ignore: No star, and the crew feels a bit sad.
events.rock.cost.scan: A walk outside adds a little radiation. Hold the button at the rock to scan. Earn a science star!
events.rock.result.scan: Scan complete! Earth will love this data. Science star earned!
events.rock.title: A strange rock appeared!
events.storm.body: A burst of radiation is coming in 20 seconds. Run for cover, or keep working and take the dose?
events.storm.cost.hide: No shelter packed: the habitat walls only block about half.
events.storm.cost.shelter: Stop what you are doing. The crew follows you.
events.storm.cost.work: Finish the experiment and earn a science star, but you take the full dose.
events.storm.result.hide: The habitat blocked about half of it. A real shelter would have blocked much more!
events.storm.result.late: Too late! The storm caught you in the open and you took the full dose.
events.storm.result.shelter: Safe! The shelter blocked most of the radiation.
events.storm.result.work: You finished the experiment, but the radiation hit hard.
events.storm.title: Solar storm warning!
events.timeout: Time ran out, so the crew did the usual thing:
events.tired.body: Long days make sleepy astronauts. Rest, or push on?
events.tired.cost.rest: The excavator stops today. Crew health goes up.
events.tired.result.rest: A good rest! Everyone feels better.
events.tired.result.work: You push on, but the crew grumbles.
events.tired.title: The crew is tired
hud.keys: Move: WASD / arrows · Open: E or Space
hud.press: Press E or tap to open: {name}
item.greenhouse.gives: 2 food + 1 oxygen a day, from day 10
menu.help1: Walk around the base with WASD / arrows, or the joystick on a phone.
menu.help2: Stand near a module and press E / Space (or the big button) to open it.
menu.help3: Time stops while a panel or card is open.
menu.help4: Hold the button near glowing rings to repair, clean, patch or scan.
menu.title: Paused
mod.battery.desc: Stores spare power for the night.
mod.battery.name: Battery bank
mod.cargo.name: Cargo pile
mod.excavator.desc: Piles Moon soil around the base as a shield.
mod.excavator.name: Regolith excavator
mod.greenhouse.desc: Grows fresh food and a bit of oxygen.
mod.greenhouse.name: Greenhouse
mod.habitat.desc: Home of the crew. It needs power to stay warm.
mod.habitat.name: Habitat
mod.habitat.needs: 2 power a day to stay warm
mod.o2gen.desc: Makes air to breathe from water and power.
mod.o2gen.name: Oxygen generator
mod.reactor.name: Small fission reactor
mod.recycler.desc: Cleans used water so it can be drunk again.
mod.recycler.name: Water recycler
mod.shelter.desc: A thick-walled room that blocks solar storm radiation.
mod.shelter.name: Storm shelter
mod.solar.desc: Turns sunlight into power. Useless in the dark.
mod.solar.name: Solar panel field
pack.check.cover: Nothing to cover you from a solar storm. A shelter or shield could help.
pack.check.good: Your plan lasts all 30 days if nothing goes wrong. But surprises will happen!
pack.check.hint: A quiet mission with no surprises:
pack.check.night: The base loses power in the dark spell (day {n}).
pack.check.nospare: No spare part: a breakdown would be hard to fix.
pack.hint.dark: Dark spells: days 9-11 and 21-23. Solar panels give nothing then!
pack.mode.easy: Easy mode is on: Radar suggests a cargo.
pack.subtitle: Tap + to add. Stay within the mass limit.
pack.title: Pack the lander
panel.clean: Hold to clean off the dust
panel.producing: Giving food and oxygen every day
radar.batteryEmpty: The battery is empty and systems are shutting off. Power comes first!
radar.dark: Dark spell! Solar panels give nothing. Keep an eye on the battery.
radar.hello: Beep boop! I am Radar, your helper robot.
radar.landed: Touchdown! Walk up to a module and press E (or tap the button) to check it.
radar.landing: Landing in 3… 2… 1… Touchdown! Walk around and check on every module.
radar.name: Radar
radar.storm.hide: No shelter packed! Hide behind the habitat.
radar.storm.shelter: Run to the shelter before the storm hits!
radar.task.dust: Walk to the solar panels and hold the button for 3 seconds.
radar.task.leak: Follow the hot/cold hint around the habitat, then hold the button on the leak.
radar.task.meteoroid: Walk to the cracked panels and hold the button.
radar.task.recycler_break: Walk to the blinking recycler and hold the button.
radar.task.rock: Walk to the glowing ring and hold the button to scan the rock.
report.evacSub: Everyone flew home safe. Every real mission learns from days like this.
report.q2: Why do you think the mission ended this way?
report.q3: What did you learn about living on the Moon?
report.successSub: You finished all {n} days on the Moon.
report.title: Mission report
sci.battery: B(t+1) = min(C, B(t) + P(t) − D(t)), with C = {cap}
sci.cargo: Each crew member uses 1 oxygen, 1 food and 1 water a day (1 unit = one astronaut for a day).
sci.dose: Game limit: {max} mSv (a game rule). Real NASA career limit: 600 mSv.
sci.excavator: +1 shield level every 5 powered days (max 3). Factors: 1.0, 0.7, 0.5, 0.35.
sci.greenhouse: From day 10: +2 food and +1 oxygen a day for 3 power + 1 water.
sci.habitat: The base needs 2 power a day. Without it health −5 a day.
sci.o2gen: Makes 4 oxygen from 3 power + 1 water a day; the crew uses 4 oxygen a day.
sci.priority: Power priority: base → oxygen → water → greenhouse → excavator
sci.reactor: Fixed 8 power a day, day and night.
sci.recycler: Recovers 98% of the crew water: 4 − 3.92 = 0.08 lost a day.
sci.shelter: Shelter: storm dose × 0.1. Hiding behind the habitat: × 0.5.
sci.shield: Game shield factor for storms: {f} (cosmic rays are reduced less)
sci.solar: Output = {n} panels × {each} power × sun {sun} × dust {dust} × damage {dmg} = {total}
start.easyHint: Radar suggests a cargo to start with.
start.nobody: Nobody gets hurt. If things go wrong, the crew flies home safe.
tip.air_plan: Plan your air first: tanks, or a generator with enough power and water.
tip.balance: Try a different plan next time. Can you finish with less mass?
tip.fix_leaks: Fix small problems fast, because they grow.
tip.food_margin: Pack a margin of food, or grow some in a greenhouse.
tip.night_power: Batteries or a reactor keep the lights on when the sun is gone.
tip.power_first: Power runs everything. Add up what each system needs, and remember the dark days.
tip.shelter_up: A storm shelter blocks most storm radiation. It is worth its 2 mass!
tip.shield_early: Start shielding early: an excavator or a ready-made shield lowers every day's dose.
tip.spares: One spare part can turn a breakdown into a small bump.
tip.water_loop: A water recycler plus a spare tank makes water last far longer.
toast.isBroken: It is broken. Fix it first!
toast.sunset: The sun has set! Solar panels give nothing for 3 days.
turning.balanced: A balanced cargo (power, air, water, food and protection) carried you through all 30 days.
turning.cold_health: On day {day} the base lost its power and got cold, and the crew fell ill.
turning.cosmic_dose: Radiation slowly added up, day after day, until it passed the safety limit on day {day}.
turning.hunger_health: On day {day} the food ran short and the crew fell ill.
turning.leak_air: An air leak left unpatched on day {day} drained the oxygen.
turning.night_survived: Your power plan carried the base through the dark days with no shutdowns.
turning.no_oxygen_gen: There was no way to make more air, and the oxygen stored in the base ran out on day {day}.
turning.no_power_air: On day {day} the oxygen generator lost power, so the air ran out.
turning.no_water_air: On day {day} the oxygen generator had no water to work with, so the air ran out.
turning.spare_saved: On day {day} a spare part fixed a breakdown and the mission kept going.
turning.storm_dose: On day {day} the solar storm hit without enough cover, and the radiation total went over the limit.
turning.storm_shelter: On day {day} you got everyone into the storm shelter, and it blocked most of the radiation.
turning.thirst_health: On day {day} the water ran short and the crew fell ill.
why.broken: Broken: fix it with a spare part
why.cracked: A panel is cracked: only half the power
why.dark: It is dark: the sun gives nothing
why.dust: Dust on the panels: 20% less power
